249: Come and see: Even though there is a set time for all the snakes in the world to shed their skins, they only shed it at the time that they are aroused by evil speech below. And likewise is that evil spirit (a different version: snake) aroused above and it sheds its skin and its scales from itself. This rises and that descends. And that shedding of the scales from its skin is the most difficult thing for it. What is the reason? Because it is separated from its mate. For were they joined together as one, the worlds would not be able to endure them. And it is all because of the arousal of evil speech below.

And when the snakes below shed that skin, each one accordingly raises its voice; and several snakes found in that place, which is called the pit, are aroused. For several snakes are found there. And they all talebear to arouse that great snake, to talebear on the world. And it is all because of the arousal of evil speech when its arousal exists below.

In this way, one occupied with the Torah — how many are there that are called holy speech, which connect and experience arousal to that place that is called holy speech! It is the speech from that Holy One above. And how many holy women and holy men are aroused from all sides! Fortunate is the portion of the righteous, the ones that arouse the holy ones above and below, holiness of above, and holiness of below.
